Question: What are the top 5 product categories by number of items sold in delivered orders? Use English category names.
text:
SELECT pct.product_category_name_english AS category,
       COUNT(*) AS items_sold
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN product_category_name_translation pct
     ON p.product_category_name = pct.product_category_name
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
GROUP BY pct.product_category_name_english
ORDER BY items_sold DESC
LIMIT 5;
-- This lists the five English product categories that sold the most items in orders marked as delivered.

Use delivered orders: order_status = 'delivered' or order_delivered_customer_date is not null. We'll assume order_status = 'delivered'. So join orders, order_items, products, product_category_name_translation. Count items per category. Order desc, limit 5. Return SELECT. Provide explanation.

SQL:

SELECT pct.product_category_name_english AS category, COUNT(*) AS items_sold
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN product_category_name_translation pct ON p.product_category_name = pct.product_category_name
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
GROUP BY pct.product_category_name_english
ORDER BY items_sold DESC
LIMIT 5;
